units: Deut. XXV, 9) [from on,] upper of the shoe.

<cite ref="Yevamot 102a:11">Yeb. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>התודה אמרה מ׳ ולא מ׳ דמ׳</he> the text says ‘from on’ (his foot) but not the cover of a cover, i.e. the upper must be immediate to the skin of the foot, v. <cite ref="A02746"><he>אַפַּנְתָּא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 102a:20">Ib.</cite> <he>א״כ ליכתוב רחמנא במ׳ רגלו</he> if it were so (that <he>חלץ</he>, Deut. l. c. meant ‘to fasten’), the text ought to have read ‘on the upper part of his foot’.
